<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover" name="viewport"/>
<title>奥尔德兰的旅印</title>
<style>

*{box-sizing:border-box;}
.center{text-align:center;}
h1, h2, h3{color:var(--arc-gold); text-align:center; letter-spacing:2px; margin:0 0 12px;}
.btn{width:100%; border:1px solid var(--arc-gold); color:var(--arc-gold); background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1B2452,#111834); border-radius:2px; padding:14px 16px; margin:10px 0; cursor:pointer; font-size:16px; letter-spacing:1px; transition:.25s; box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.35);}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px); background:var(--arc-gold); color:#0B1024; box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(225,184,92,.45);}
.btn-small{width:auto; padding:8px 14px; display:inline-block; font-size:13px; margin:4px 4px 14px 0;}
.card{border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.32); background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(17,24,52,.96),rgba(11,16,36,.96)); border-radius:2px; padding:14px; margin:10px 0; box-shadow:inset 0 0 18px rgba(255,255,255,.025);}
.opt{cursor:pointer; transition:.22s;}
.opt:hover{border-color:var(--arc-gold); transform:translateY(-1px);}
.opt.selected{border-color:var(--arc-gold); box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(225,184,92,.25), inset 0 0 18px rgba(225,184,92,.08);}
.opt strong{color:#f3d58c; display:block; margin-bottom:6px;}
.opt p{margin:0; color:#9AA0C0; line-height:1.6; font-size:13px;}
.grid2{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:10px;}
.grid3{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:10px;}
input, select, textarea{width:100%; background:#0D1330; border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.28); color:#E7E4F2; border-radius:2px; padding:11px; margin:6px 0 12px; font-family:inherit;}
textarea{min-height:90px; resize:vertical;}
label{color:#E1B85C; font-size:13px; display:block; margin-top:6px;}
details{border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.32); border-radius:2px; margin:10px 0; background:rgba(11,16,36,.86); overflow:hidden;}
summary{cursor:pointer; list-style:none; color:#f3d58c; padding:14px; font-weight:bold; background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(91,48,24,.45),rgba(17,24,52,.8));}
summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none;}
.detail-body{padding:14px; line-height:1.8; color:#C9CCE0; font-size:14px;}
.badges{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px; margin:8px 0;}
.badge{font-size:11px; color:#0D1330; background:var(--arc-gold); padding:3px 8px; border-radius:2px; font-weight:bold;}
.world-svg{position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; display:block;}
.map-gridline{stroke:rgba(255,255,255,.08); stroke-width:1;}
.map-ocean-label{fill:rgba(189,225,255,.28); font-size:26px; letter-spacing:7px; font-weight:700;}
.map-region-label{fill:rgba(255,239,193,.38); font-size:22px; letter-spacing:5px; font-weight:700;}
.map-pole-label{fill:rgba(200,239,255,.78); font-size:18px; letter-spacing:4px; font-weight:700;}
.atlas-wide{max-width:1180px;}
.atlas-toc{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:10px; margin:16px 0 18px;}
.atlas-link{text-decoration:none; color:#f3d58c; border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.36); border-radius:2px; padding:12px 10px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(17,24,52,.95),rgba(12,13,20,.96)); transition:.22s; min-height:88px; display:block;}
.atlas-link:hover{transform:translateY(-2px); border-color:var(--arc-gold); box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(225,184,92,.18);}
.atlas-link b{display:block; color:#F7E7B8; margin-bottom:5px; font-size:14px;}
.atlas-link span{display:block; color:#9AA0C0; line-height:1.55; font-size:12px;}
.atlas-section-card{border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.34); border-radius:2px; margin:15px 0; padding:16px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(13,15,24,.94),rgba(8,12,30,.97)); box-shadow:inset 0 0 28px rgba(255,255,255,.02);}
.atlas-section-head{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; padding-bottom:10px; margin-bottom:12px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.18);}
.atlas-section-head h3{margin:0; text-align:left; color:var(--arc-gold); font-size:21px;}
.atlas-section-head .sigil{color:#0c1017; background:var(--arc-gold); border-radius:2px; padding:4px 10px; font-size:12px; font-weight:bold; white-space:nowrap;}
.atlas-note{line-height:1.85; color:#C9CCE0; font-size:14px; padding:10px 12px; border-left:4px solid rgba(92,214,210,.78); background:rgba(92,214,210,.055); border-radius:2px; margin:8px 0 12px;}
.atlas-rule-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:10px;}
.rule-tile{border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.24); border-radius:2px; padding:12px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.032); line-height:1.75; font-size:13px; color:#C9CCE0;}
.rule-tile b{color:#f3d58c;}
.rule-tile.full{grid-column:1/-1;}
.atlas-list{margin:8px 0 0 0; padding-left:18px; line-height:1.78; color:#C9CCE0; font-size:13px;}
.atlas-list li{margin:5px 0;}
.tier-row{display:grid; grid-template-columns:120px 1fr; gap:8px; border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(225,184,92,.17); padding:8px 0; font-size:13px; line-height:1.7;}
.tier-row:last-child{border-bottom:0;}
.tier-name{color:#F7E7B8; font-weight:bold;}
.atlas-mini-title{color:#5CD6D2; font-weight:bold; margin:8px 0 6px;}
.atlas-map-panel{margin-top:14px;}
.atlas-danger{color:#ff9aa5;}
.atlas-holy{color:#F3D58C;}
@media(max-width:900px){.atlas-toc{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));}
.atlas-rule-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
.tier-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
.atlas-section-head{align-items:flex-start; flex-direction:column;}
 }
@media(max-width:620px){.atlas-toc{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
 }
@media(max-width:620px){.grid2, .grid3{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
 }
.chronicle-toolbar{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; margin:12px 0 14px;}
.chronicle-era-tab{border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.35); color:#f3d58c; background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(17,24,52,.96),rgba(8,12,30,.98)); border-radius:2px; padding:8px 12px; cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit; font-size:12px; transition:.2s;}
.chronicle-era-tab:hover{transform:translateY(-1px); border-color:var(--arc-gold); box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(225,184,92,.18);}
.chronicle-era-tab.active{color:#0B1024; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#F3D58C,#B08D3C); border-color:#F3D58C; font-weight:bold;}
.chronicle-era{display:none; border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.28); border-radius:2px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(11,16,36,.92),rgba(6,7,12,.96)); padding:14px; margin-top:10px; box-shadow:inset 0 0 24px rgba(255,255,255,.02);}
.chronicle-era.active{display:block; animation:arcFadeIn .22s ease both;}
.chronicle-era h4{color:#F7E7B8; margin:0 0 8px; font-size:18px; letter-spacing:1px;}
.chronicle-subtitle{color:#5CD6D2; margin:0 0 12px; font-size:13px; letter-spacing:1px;}
.chronicle-row{display:grid; grid-template-columns:128px 1fr; gap:10px; padding:9px 0; border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(225,184,92,.18); line-height:1.75; color:#C9CCE0; font-size:13px;}
.chronicle-row:last-child{border-bottom:0;}
.chronicle-row b{color:#f3d58c;}
.chronicle-tagline{border-left:4px solid rgba(225,184,92,.8); background:rgba(225,184,92,.055); border-radius:2px; padding:10px 12px; line-height:1.8; color:#C9CCE0; margin:10px 0 12px;}
@media(max-width:700px){.chronicle-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
.chronicle-toolbar{gap:6px;}
.chronicle-era-tab{font-size:11px;padding:7px 10px;}
 }
.chronicle-calendar-panel{border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.28);border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.035),rgba(0,0,0,.16));padding:14px;margin:14px 0 16px;}
.chronicle-calendar-panel h4{margin:0 0 8px;color:#F7E7B8;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:1px;}
.chronicle-calendar-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;}
.chronicle-calendar-item{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:2px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.18);padding:10px;line-height:1.65;color:#d6c5a7;font-size:13px;}
.chronicle-calendar-item b{display:block;color:#f3d58c;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:2px;}
.chronicle-era-calendar{margin:8px 0 12px;border-left:4px solid rgba(225,184,92,.72);background:rgba(225,184,92,.055);padding:9px 11px;border-radius:2px;color:#C9CCE0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.75;}
.strongest-year{color:#C9CCE0;background:rgba(225,184,92,.055);border-left:3px solid rgba(225,184,92,.65);padding:8px 10px;border-radius:2px;}
@media(max-width:760px){.chronicle-calendar-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
.chronicle-calendar-panel h4{font-size:18px;}
}
.chronicle-view{display:none;}
.chronicle-view.active{display:block; animation:arcFadeIn .18s ease both;}
.chronicle-modebar{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:flex-end; gap:8px; margin-top:14px; padding-top:12px; border-top:1px dashed rgba(225,184,92,.24); color:#9AA0C0; font-size:12px;}
.chronicle-mode-btn{border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.38); color:#f3d58c; background:rgba(255,255,255,.035); border-radius:2px; padding:7px 12px; cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit; transition:.18s;}
.chronicle-mode-btn:hover{border-color:var(--arc-gold); transform:translateY(-1px);}
.chronicle-mode-btn.active{color:#0B1024; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#F3D58C,#B08D3C); border-color:#F3D58C; font-weight:bold;}
.chronicle-fulltext{line-height:1.95; color:#d4c4aa; font-size:13px;}
.chronicle-fulltext p{margin:0 0 12px; text-indent:2em;}
.chronicle-fulltext p:first-child{text-indent:0;}
@media(max-width:620px){.chronicle-modebar{justify-content:flex-start; flex-wrap:wrap;}
 }
.atlas-pane-stage{position:relative;}
.atlas-pane{display:none; animation:arcFadeIn .22s ease both;}
.atlas-pane.active{display:block;}
@keyframes arcFadeIn{ from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(6px); } to { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); } }
.world-svg{pointer-events:none;}
.alignment-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:10px;}
@media(max-width:700px){.alignment-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
 }
.custom-start-box{border:1px dashed rgba(225,184,92,.38);border-radius:2px;padding:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);margin:10px 0 14px}
#page-atlas:not(.active) .atlas-map-panel{display:none!important}
#page-atlas.active .atlas-map-panel{display:block}
a.btn{display:block; text-align:center; text-decoration:none;}
.strongest-toolbar{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; margin:14px 0 16px;}
.strongest-tab{border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.34); background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(17,24,52,.96),rgba(8,12,30,.98)); color:#f3d58c; border-radius:2px; padding:8px 12px; cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit; font-size:12px; transition:.2s;}
.strongest-tab:hover{transform:translateY(-1px); border-color:var(--arc-gold); box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(225,184,92,.18);}
.strongest-tab.active{color:#0B1024; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#F3D58C,#B08D3C); border-color:#F3D58C; font-weight:bold;}
.strongest-stage{border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.22); border-radius:2px; padding:12px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(11,16,36,.72),rgba(6,7,12,.88));}
.strongest-pane{display:none;}
.strongest-pane.active{display:block; animation:arcFadeIn .2s ease both;}
.strongest-module-head{border-left:4px solid rgba(225,184,92,.82); padding:4px 0 6px 12px; margin-bottom:10px;}
.strongest-module-head h4{margin:0 0 4px; color:#F7E7B8; font-size:18px; letter-spacing:1px;}
.strongest-module-head span{color:#5CD6D2; font-size:12px;}
.strongest-intro{color:#C9CCE0; line-height:1.8; background:rgba(255,255,255,.035); border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.16); border-radius:2px; padding:10px 12px; margin:10px 0 12px;}
.strongest-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:10px;}
.strongest-card{border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.28); border-radius:2px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(17,24,52,.92),rgba(8,12,30,.96)); padding:12px; box-shadow:inset 0 0 18px rgba(255,255,255,.02);}
.strongest-card-title{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; align-items:flex-start; border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(225,184,92,.18); padding-bottom:7px; margin-bottom:8px;}
.strongest-card-title b{color:#F3D58C; font-size:14px;}
.strongest-card-title span{color:#8fffd2; font-size:11px; text-align:right; min-width:96px;}
.strongest-meta{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px; margin-bottom:8px;}
.strongest-meta span{border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.22); border-radius:2px; padding:2px 7px; color:#D9C48A; font-size:11px; background:rgba(225,184,92,.06);}
.strongest-card p{margin:6px 0; line-height:1.65; color:#C9CCE0; font-size:12px;}
.strongest-card p b{color:#f3d58c;}
@media(max-width:820px){.strongest-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
.strongest-card-title{display:block;}
.strongest-card-title span{display:block;text-align:left;margin-top:4px;}
 }
.companion-intro{color:#C9CCE0; line-height:1.8; background:rgba(255,255,255,.035); border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.16); border-radius:2px; padding:10px 12px; margin:10px 0 12px;}
.companion-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:14px;}
.companion-card{display:grid; grid-template-columns:168px minmax(0,1fr); gap:14px; border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.28); border-radius:2px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(17,24,52,.92),rgba(8,12,30,.96)); padding:12px; box-shadow:inset 0 0 18px rgba(255,255,255,.02);}
.companion-portrait{border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.24); border-radius:2px; overflow:hidden; min-height:220px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(17,24,52,.92),rgba(8,12,30,.98)); box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(0,0,0,.28), inset 0 0 12px rgba(255,255,255,.025);}
.companion-portrait img{width:100%; height:100%; display:block; object-fit:cover;}
.companion-main{min-width:0;}
.companion-title{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; align-items:flex-start; border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(225,184,92,.16); padding-bottom:7px; margin-bottom:8px;}
.companion-title b{color:#F3D58C; font-size:18px;}
.companion-title span{color:#8fffd2; font-size:12px; text-align:right;}
.companion-tags, .companion-traits{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px; margin:0 0 8px;}
.companion-tags span, .companion-traits span{border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.22); border-radius:2px; padding:3px 8px; color:#D9C48A; font-size:11px; background:rgba(225,184,92,.06);}
.companion-card p{margin:6px 0; line-height:1.7; color:#C9CCE0; font-size:12px;}
.companion-card p b{color:#f3d58c;}
.companion-card .minor{color:#aeb8c8;}
@media(max-width:900px){.companion-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
 }
@media(max-width:680px){.companion-card{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
.companion-portrait{min-height:320px;}
.companion-title{display:block;}
.companion-title span{display:block;text-align:left;margin-top:4px;}
 }
.double-king-timeline{border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.28);border-radius:2px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.18);padding:12px;margin-top:10px;}
.timeline-lanes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;}
.timeline-lane{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:2px;padding:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);}
.timeline-lane h6{margin:0 0 8px;color:#F7E7B8;font-size:14px;}
.timeline-node{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;margin:6px 0;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:2px;border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.22);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(18,20,31,.92),rgba(8,12,30,.95));color:#C9CCE0;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;transition:.18s;}
.timeline-node b{display:block;color:#f3d58c;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:2px;}
.timeline-node span{display:block;color:#5CD6D2;font-size:11px;}
.timeline-node:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);border-color:rgba(225,184,92,.55);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(225,184,92,.12);}
.timeline-node.active{border-color:#F3D58C;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(246,216,141,.18),rgba(44,30,12,.25));box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(225,184,92,.22) inset;}
.timeline-detail-panel{margin-top:12px;border-top:1px dashed rgba(225,184,92,.25);padding-top:10px;}
.timeline-node-detail{display:none;color:#d2c2a9;line-height:1.8;font-size:13px;}
.timeline-node-detail.active{display:block;animation:arcFadeIn .18s ease both;}
.timeline-node-detail b{color:#F3D58C;display:block;margin-bottom:5px;}
.timeline-node-detail p{margin:0;text-indent:2em;}
.chronicle-hr{border:0;border-top:1px dashed rgba(225,184,92,.25);margin:12px 0;}
.chronicle-detail-subtitle{color:#5CD6D2;font-weight:bold;margin:8px 0;}
@media(max-width:720px){.timeline-lanes{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.timeline-node-detail p{text-indent:0}
}
.chronicle-era h4{font-size:24px; line-height:1.35; margin-bottom:6px;}
.chronicle-subtitle{font-size:14px; line-height:1.65; color:#9fe2ff;}
.chronicle-tagline{font-size:14px; line-height:1.85; padding:12px 14px;}
.chronicle-row{grid-template-columns:150px 1fr; font-size:14px; line-height:1.9; padding:11px 0;}
.chronicle-fulltext{max-width:1040px; margin:0 auto; font-size:15.5px; line-height:2.15; text-align:left; color:#dfd0b8;}
.chronicle-fulltext h5{font-size:25px; line-height:1.35; color:#fff2bf; margin:4px 0 8px; text-align:left; letter-spacing:1px;}
.chronicle-fulltext h6{font-size:17px; line-height:1.65; color:#7FE3DE; margin:4px 0 18px; text-align:left; letter-spacing:.5px;}
.chronicle-fulltext p{margin:0 0 16px; text-indent:2em; text-align:left;}
.chronicle-fulltext p:first-child{text-indent:0;}
.chronicle-hr{border:0; border-top:1px dashed rgba(225,184,92,.28); margin:22px 0;}
.chronicle-modebar{justify-content:flex-start; font-size:13px;}
.chronicle-mode-btn{padding:8px 14px;}
@media(max-width:700px){.chronicle-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
.chronicle-fulltext{font-size:14.5px; line-height:2;}
.chronicle-era h4{font-size:21px;}
 }
.chronicle-yearbook .chronicle-row{grid-template-columns:150px 1fr;align-items:start;}
.chronicle-yearbook .chronicle-row b{font-size:13px;color:#F3D58C;}
.chronicle-yearbook .chronicle-row span{font-size:13px;line-height:1.9;}
@media(max-width:700px){.chronicle-yearbook .chronicle-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
}
.skill-card{border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.22); border-radius:2px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.025); padding:12px;}
.skill-card h4{margin:0 0 8px; color:#f3d58c; font-size:15px; letter-spacing:.5px;}
.skill-card p{margin:0 0 8px; color:#C9CCE0; line-height:1.75; font-size:13px;}
.skill-list{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:8px; margin-top:8px;}
.skill-pill{border:1px solid rgba(92,214,210,.22); background:rgba(92,214,210,.055); border-radius:2px; padding:8px 10px; color:#D7F5F3; font-size:12px; line-height:1.65;}
.skill-pill b{color:#F7E7B8;}
.skill-footnote{margin-top:10px; color:#9AA0C0; font-size:12px; line-height:1.7;}
@media(max-width:760px){.skill-list{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
 }
.legend-portrait .portrait-caption{padding:6px 8px;
  color:#cdbb91;
  font-size:11px;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.16);
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.25);}
.strongest-side-portrait .portrait-caption{margin-top:8px;
  padding:7px 8px;
  color:#f3d58c;
  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1.5;
  border-radius:2px;
  background:rgba(225,184,92,.055);
  border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.14);}
@media(max-width:820px){.strongest-side-portrait{position:relative;top:auto;}
.strongest-side-portrait img{height:380px;}
.legend-portrait img{height:260px;}

}
.legend-portrait{margin:10px 0 12px; border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.34); border-radius:2px; overflow:hidden; background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 18%, rgba(225,184,92,.12), rgba(8,12,30,.96) 62%);}
.legend-portrait img{width:100%; height:720px; object-fit:contain; object-position:center center; display:block; background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 20%, rgba(225,184,92,.10), rgba(6,9,26,.98) 70%);}
.strongest-side-portrait{border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.38); border-radius:2px; overflow:hidden; background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 18%, rgba(225,184,92,.12), rgba(8,12,30,.98) 68%);}

  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.14),rgba(255,255,255,0) 46%);}

.bgm-panel{position:fixed;z-index:9001;left:0;top:0;display:none;flex-direction:column;width:300px;

.bgm-k{display:block;color:#9AA0C0;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;}

.bgm-vol{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:4px 10px 10px 8px;}
.bgm-mode{flex:none;margin:0 0 0 4px;padding:3px 10px;border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.3);border-radius:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);
  color:#c2b391;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;}

.bgm-panel input[type=range]{-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;flex:1;width:auto;min-width:0;height:18px;margin:0;padding:0;
  border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;box-shadow:none;cursor:pointer;accent-color:#E1B85C;}

  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#E1B85C var(--v,0%),rgba(225,184,92,.18) var(--v,0%));}

:root{
 --void:#0B1024; --void2:#06091A; --nebula:#1B2452; --panel:rgba(8,12,30,.80); --panel2:rgba(20,27,58,.72); --panel3:#111834;
 --text:#E7E4F2; --text2:#C9CCE0; --muted:#9AA0C0; --gold:#E1B85C; --gold2:#F3D58C; --ether:#5CD6D2; --line:#2A3566; --line-gold:rgba(225,184,92,.38);
 --paper:#F5EDDC; --paper2:#E9DCC3; --paper3:#FBF5E8; --ink:#2A1B10; --ink2:#3B2A1A; --ink3:#5A4630; --ink4:#8A7458; --seal:#8E2A22; --pgold:#B08D3C; --rule:#C9B58F; --rule2:#D9C8A6;
 --arc-gold:var(--gold); --arc-bg:var(--void); --arc-panel:#111834; --arc-panel2:#141B3A; --arc-text:var(--text); --arc-soft:var(--muted); --arc-border:var(--line); --arc-blue:var(--ether); --arc-green:#85e6a8; --arc-purple:#d7a2ff; --arc-red:#ff6b7a; --arc-fire:#ff9d52;
 --f-serif:"Noto Serif SC","Songti SC","STSong","Source Han Serif SC","Microsoft YaHei",serif; --f-latin:"Cinzel","Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif; --f-ital:"Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif;
 --sat:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px); --sab:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;height:100%}
body{background:var(--void);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--f-serif);font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;overflow:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
button{font-family:inherit}
a{color:var(--gold)}
#sc-gate h1,#sc-menu h1,#sc-temple h2,#sc-temple h3,#sc-build h2,#sc-build h3,#sc-journal h2,#sc-journal h3,#sc-seal h2,#cx-map h2,#cx-map h3,.cx-top h1,.modal-box h2{text-align:left;margin:0;letter-spacing:.04em}
#sc-temple label,#sc-build label,#sc-seal label,.modal-box label{font-size:12px;margin:0;display:block}
::selection{background:rgba(225,184,92,.35)}

/* ===== 星穹外壳 ===== */
#app{position:fixed;inset:0;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 20%,#1B2452 0%,#0B1024 55%,#06091A 100%)}
#app:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.9;
 background:
 radial-gradient(circle at 18% 22%,rgba(255,255,255,.9) .8px,rgba(255,255,255,0) 1.6px),
 radial-gradient(circle at 42% 68%,rgba(255,255,255,.7) .8px,rgba(255,255,255,0) 1.6px),
 radial-gradient(circle at 63% 14%,rgba(255,255,255,.85) 1px,rgba(255,255,255,0) 2px),
 radial-gradient(circle at 81% 52%,rgba(255,255,255,.6) .8px,rgba(255,255,255,0) 1.6px),
 radial-gradient(circle at 92% 82%,rgba(255,255,255,.8) .8px,rgba(255,255,255,0) 1.6px),
 radial-gradient(circle at 30% 88%,rgba(255,255,255,.6) .8px,rgba(255,255,255,0) 1.6px),
 radial-gradient(circle at 55% 40%,rgba(92,214,210,.9) 1px,rgba(92,214,210,0) 2.2px),
 radial-gradient(circle at 8% 55%,rgba(255,255,255,.5) .7px,rgba(255,255,255,0) 1.4px),
 radial-gradient(circle at 74% 30%,rgba(255,255,255,.55) .7px,rgba(255,255,255,0) 1.4px),
 radial-gradient(circle at 48% 8%,rgba(225,184,92,.8) .9px,rgba(225,184,92,0) 1.8px),
 radial-gradient(circle at 24% 40%,rgba(255,255,255,.45) .6px,rgba(255,255,255,0) 1.2px),
 radial-gradient(circle at 88% 12%,rgba(255,255,255,.5) .7px,rgba(255,255,255,0) 1.4px),
 radial-gradient(circle at 66% 90%,rgba(92,214,210,.6) .8px,rgba(92,214,210,0) 1.6px),
 radial-gradient(circle at 12% 8%,rgba(255,255,255,.4) .6px,rgba(255,255,255,0) 1.2px),
 radial-gradient(circle at 96% 40%,rgba(255,255,255,.45) .6px,rgba(255,255,255,0) 1.2px),
 radial-gradient(circle at 36% 24%,rgba(255,255,255,.35) .6px,rgba(255,255,255,0) 1.2px);
 background-size:100% 100%;animation:starDrift 90s linear infinite alternate}
@keyframes starDrift{from{transform:translate3d(0,0,0)}to{transform:translate3d(-14px,8px,0)}}
.sc{position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;overflow:hidden}
.sc.on{display:flex;animation:scIn .45s ease both}
@keyframes scIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.scroll{overflow-y:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;overscroll-behavior:contain}

.latin{font-family:var(--f-latin);letter-spacing:.3em;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase}
.ital{font-family:var(--f-ital);font-style:italic}
.kicker{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--gold)}
.muted{color:var(--muted)}
.hair{height:1px;background:var(--line);border:0;margin:0}
.hair.gold{background:var(--line-gold)}

/* 通用按钮（星穹） */
.k-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:11px 20px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel2);color:var(--text2);font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.08em;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;text-decoration:none;line-height:1.3}
.k-btn:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--text)}
.k-btn.gold{background:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--void);font-weight:600}
.k-btn.gold:hover{background:var(--gold2);border-color:var(--gold2)}
.k-btn.ghost{background:transparent}
.k-btn.sm{padding:7px 13px;font-size:12.5px}
.k-btn[disabled]{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
.k-btn svg{width:16px;height:16px;flex:none}

/* ===== 开门 ===== */
#sc-gate{align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center}
.gate{position:relative;width:min(720px,92vw);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:24px 0}
.gate-seal{position:relative;width:228px;height:228px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.gate-seal img{width:196px;height:196px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;display:block;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(225,184,92,.55),0 30px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 0 60px rgba(225,184,92,.15)}
.gate-seal .ring{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.35);animation:spin 60s linear infinite}
.gate-seal .ring:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:-3px;width:6px;height:6px;margin-left:-3px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 12px 3px rgba(225,184,92,.6)}
.gate-seal .ring2{position:absolute;inset:14px;border-radius:50%;border:1px dashed rgba(92,214,210,.35);animation:spin 44s linear infinite reverse}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.gate h1{font-size:64px;line-height:1.05;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.02em;color:#F4F1FA;text-align:center}
.gate .tag{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;color:var(--gold);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.3em}
.gate .tag:before,.gate .tag:after{content:"";width:48px;height:1px;background:var(--gold)}
.gate-pro{max-width:560px;color:var(--text2);font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.95;text-align:center}
.gate-pro p{margin:0 0 10px;opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .9s ease forwards}
.gate-pro p:nth-child(1){animation-delay:.3s}.gate-pro p:nth-child(2){animation-delay:1s}.gate-pro p:nth-child(3){animation-delay:1.7s}
@keyframes fadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.gate .k-btn.gold{margin-top:6px;padding:15px 44px;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:.24em}
.gate-foot{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.14em}

#sc-menu{align-items:stretch}
.menu{position:relative;width:100%;display:flex}
.menu-left{position:relative;z-index:2;width:min(640px,100%);padding:9vh 40px 40px 8vw;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px}
.menu h1{font-size:68px;line-height:1.05;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.02em;color:#F4F1FA}
.menu .tag{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;color:var(--gold);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.3em}
.menu .tag:before{content:"";width:56px;height:1px;background:var(--gold)}
.menu-quote{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:17px;line-height:1.9;color:var(--text2)}
.menu-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;width:min(480px,100%);margin-top:auto}
.menu-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:15px 20px;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);color:#F4F1FA;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;width:100%}
.menu-item:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateX(4px)}
.menu-item.primary{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(225,184,92,.16),rgba(225,184,92,.04));border-color:var(--gold)}
.menu-item .num{font-family:var(--f-latin);font-size:18px;color:var(--ether);width:28px;flex:none}
.menu-item.primary .num{color:var(--gold)}
.menu-item .tt{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;flex:1}
.menu-item .tt b{font-size:19px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.04em}
.menu-item .tt span{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.menu-item svg{width:18px;height:18px;flex:none}
.menu-foot{display:flex;gap:18px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.menu-foot button{border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);padding:0;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;letter-spacing:.06em}
.menu-foot button:hover{color:var(--gold)}
.menu-foot svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.menu-right{position:absolute;right:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:56%;pointer-events:none}
.menu-sigil{position:absolute;right:6vw;top:50%;width:min(620px,60vh);height:min(620px,60vh);transform:translateY(-50%);opacity:.9}
.menu-sigil .rot{transform-origin:50% 50%;animation:spin 240s linear infinite}
.menu-sigil .rot2{transform-origin:50% 50%;animation:spin 160s linear infinite reverse}
.menu-note{position:absolute;right:8vw;top:10vh;width:280px;text-align:right;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;pointer-events:auto}
.menu-note .latin{font-size:12px}
.menu-note p{margin:0;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--muted)}
.menu-ver{position:absolute;right:88px;bottom:16px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.1em;opacity:.7}

/* ===== 世界之书 ===== */
#sc-codex{flex-direction:column}
.cx-top{flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:calc(12px + var(--sat)) 28px 12px;background:rgba(8,12,30,.92);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-gold);position:relative;z-index:5}
.cx-title{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:14px}
.cx-title h1{font-size:22px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#F4F1FA}
.cx-nav{flex:none;position:relative;z-index:4;background:rgba(8,12,30,.85);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.cx-vols{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0;padding:0 28px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none}
.cx-vols::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.cx-vol{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:8px 14px 8px 0;margin-right:14px;flex:none}
.cx-vol .vl{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--gold);padding-right:10px;border-right:1px solid var(--line);margin-right:4px;white-space:nowrap}
.cx-tab{border:1px solid transparent;background:transparent;color:var(--text2);padding:6px 11px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:.04em;transition:.18s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.cx-tab:hover{color:var(--text);border-color:var(--line)}
.cx-tab.on{color:#F4F1FA;background:rgba(225,184,92,.16);border-color:var(--gold)}
.cx-tab i{font-style:normal;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:0}
.cx-tab.spoil i{color:#ff9aa5}
.cx-stage{flex:1;min-height:0;position:relative;overflow-y:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;overscroll-behavior:contain;padding:0 0 calc(80px + var(--sab))}
.cx-panes{width:100%;max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:6px 18px 0}
.cx-stage .atlas-pane{margin-top:14px}
.cx-stage .atlas-section-card{margin:14px 0}
.cx-stage.map-mode{overflow:hidden;padding-bottom:0}
.cx-stage.map-mode .cx-panes{display:none}
#cx-map{display:none;position:absolute;inset:0}
#cx-map.active{display:block}

/* ===== 大陆全图 ===== */
.mp{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;background:#0B1024}
.mp-view{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;cursor:grab;touch-action:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%,#17204A,#0B1024 70%)}
.mp-view.drag{cursor:grabbing}
.mp-world{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;transform-origin:0 0;will-change:transform}
.mp-world img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;user-select:none;-webkit-user-drag:none;pointer-events:none;filter:saturate(.92) brightness(.96)}
.mp-shade{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(11,16,36,.35),rgba(11,16,36,.05) 30%,rgba(11,16,36,.05) 70%,rgba(11,16,36,.4));mix-blend-mode:multiply}
.mp-markers{position:absolute;inset:0;--inv:1}
.mk{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(var(--inv,1));display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;background:transparent;border:0;padding:6px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text);pointer-events:auto}
.mk .dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c,#E1B85C);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(11,16,36,.7),0 0 12px 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--c,#E1B85C) 55%,transparent);transition:.2s}
.mk .lb{font-size:11px;line-height:1.2;padding:2px 6px;background:rgba(8,12,30,.78);border:1px solid rgba(42,53,102,.9);color:var(--text);white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:.02em;text-shadow:0 1px 2px #000;opacity:0;transform:translateY(-2px);transition:.2s;pointer-events:none}
.mk.lbl .lb,.mk:hover .lb,.mk.on .lb{opacity:1;transform:none}
.mk.on .dot{transform:scale(1.35);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(225,184,92,.9),0 0 18px 6px rgba(225,184,92,.55)}
.mk.on .lb{border-color:var(--gold);color:#F4F1FA}
.mk.dim{opacity:.28}
.mk.core .dot{width:14px;height:14px}
.mk.core{z-index:3}
.mp-side{position:absolute;left:18px;top:18px;width:290px;max-height:calc(100% - 92px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;padding:12px 12px 10px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);z-index:6}
.mp-side input{width:100%;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#0B1024;color:var(--text);font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;outline:0;margin:0}
.mp-side input:focus{border-color:var(--gold)}
.mp-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px}
.chip{border:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;padding:3px 8px;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:.04em;line-height:1.4}
.chip.on{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}
.chip:hover{color:var(--text)}
.mp-region{font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--text2);padding:8px 10px;background:rgba(20,27,58,.6);border-left:2px solid var(--gold);display:none}
.mp-region.on{display:block}
.mp-region b{color:#F4F1FA}
.mp-region a{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--gold);cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;display:inline-block;margin-top:3px}
.mp-list{overflow-y:auto;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px;font-size:13px}
.mp-list button{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:7px 10px;border:0;border-left:2px solid transparent;background:transparent;color:var(--text2);text-align:left;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px}
.mp-list button:hover{color:#F4F1FA;background:rgba(20,27,58,.6)}
.mp-list button.on{color:#F4F1FA;background:rgba(225,184,92,.14);border-left-color:var(--gold)}
.mp-list button span{color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;flex:none}
.mp-count{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.mp-side-toggle{display:none}
.mp-ctl{position:absolute;right:18px;bottom:96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;z-index:6}
.mp-ctl button{width:36px;height:36px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);color:var(--text);font-size:18px;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0}
.mp-ctl button.wide{width:auto;padding:0 12px;font-size:12px}
.mp-ctl button svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.mp-legend{position:absolute;left:18px;bottom:18px;display:flex;gap:12px;padding:7px 12px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);z-index:6;flex-wrap:wrap;max-width:min(680px,calc(100% - 60px))}
.mp-legend span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;white-space:nowrap}
.mp-legend i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block}
.mp-hint{position:absolute;left:50%;top:18px;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text2);padding:5px 12px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);z-index:5;pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:.04em}
/* 地标详情卡 */
.mp-card{position:absolute;right:18px;top:18px;width:400px;max-height:calc(100% - 36px);display:none;flex-direction:column;background:rgba(8,12,30,.97);border:1px solid var(--line-gold);box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.5);z-index:7;overflow:hidden}
.mp-card.on{display:flex}
.mp-card .close{position:absolute;right:8px;top:8px;width:30px;height:30px;border:1px solid rgba(42,53,102,.8);background:rgba(8,12,30,.7);color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:2;padding:0}
.mp-card .close svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.mp-art{position:relative;height:190px;flex:none;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#2A3F78 0%,#4C6FA8 36%,#93A9CC 60%,#C9BC9C 78%,#5E6A50 79%,#2F3A2A 100%)}
.mp-art img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.mp-art .cap{position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:10px;right:56px;font-size:11px;padding:2px 6px;background:rgba(8,12,30,.72);color:#F4F1FA;line-height:1.5;max-height:52px;overflow:hidden}
.mp-art .dots{position:absolute;right:12px;bottom:12px;display:flex;gap:4px}
.mp-art .dots i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(225,184,92,.4);cursor:pointer}
.mp-art .dots i.on{background:var(--gold)}
.mp-art .arr{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:28px;height:44px;border:0;background:rgba(8,12,30,.45);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0}
.mp-art .arr.l{left:0}.mp-art .arr.r{right:0}
.mp-art .arr svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.mp-art .ph{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em}
.mp-art .ph svg{width:34px;height:34px;opacity:.7}
.mp-body{overflow-y:auto;min-height:0;padding:14px 18px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.mp-body h2{font-size:21px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#F4F1FA;line-height:1.3}
.mp-body .sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.mp-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px}
.mp-tags span{font-size:10.5px;padding:2px 7px;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--text2)}
.mp-facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px;font-size:12px}
.mp-facts div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;padding:7px 10px;background:rgba(20,27,58,.8);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.mp-facts span{color:var(--muted);font-size:11px}
.mp-facts b{color:#F4F1FA;font-weight:600;line-height:1.5}
.mp-facts div.w{grid-column:1/-1}
.mp-text{font-size:13px;line-height:1.75;color:var(--text2)}
.mp-text b{color:var(--gold);font-weight:600}
.mp-text p{margin:0 0 6px}
.mp-acts{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:4px}
.mp-acts .k-btn{flex:1;padding:9px 12px;font-size:13px}

/* ===== 神殿 ===== */
#sc-temple{flex-direction:column}
.tp{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow-y:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;padding:calc(20px + var(--sat)) 20px calc(60px + var(--sab))}
.tp-in{width:min(980px,100%);margin:0 auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:22px;align-items:center}
.tp-step{display:none;width:100%;flex-direction:column;gap:20px;align-items:center}
.tp-step.on{display:flex;animation:scIn .4s ease both}
.tp-head{text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.tp-head .ital{font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--muted)}
.tp-head h2{font-size:26px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#F4F1FA}
.tp-head p{margin:0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.9;color:var(--text2);max-width:720px}
.tp-pro{width:min(720px,100%);font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.95;color:var(--text2);padding:18px 24px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);position:relative}
.tp-pro b{color:#F4F1FA;font-weight:600}
.tp-pro i{color:var(--muted)}
.tp-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;width:100%}
.tp-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;padding:20px 20px 18px;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--text);text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;position:relative}
.tp-card:hover{border-color:var(--gold)}
.tp-card.active{border-color:var(--gold);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(225,184,92,.14),rgba(225,184,92,.04));box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--gold)}
.tp-card .num{font-family:var(--f-latin);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--muted)}
.tp-card.active .num{color:var(--gold)}
.tp-card b{font-size:20px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.04em}
.tp-card .tg{font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--gold)}
.tp-card p{margin:0;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.75;color:var(--text2)}
.tp-card p i{color:var(--muted);display:block;margin-top:6px}
.tp-note{width:min(720px,100%);font-size:14px;line-height:1.9;color:var(--text2);padding:14px 20px;border-left:2px solid var(--gold);background:rgba(225,184,92,.07)}
.tp-note b{color:#F4F1FA;font-weight:600}
.tp-row{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;width:100%}
.tp-back{position:absolute;left:20px;top:calc(14px + var(--sat));z-index:3}
/* 睁眼之前：表单 */
.form{width:min(820px,100%);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}
.form h3{font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--gold);font-weight:600;display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px}
.form h3 small{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.04em;font-weight:400}
.form .hint{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7;margin-top:-8px}
.form input,.form textarea,.form select{width:100%;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#0B1024;color:var(--text);font-family:inherit;font-size:14px;margin:0;outline:0;border-radius:0}
.form input:focus,.form textarea:focus{border-color:var(--gold)}
.form textarea{min-height:84px;resize:vertical}
.fi-row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.fi-row>*{flex:1 1 160px}
.fi-row .k-btn{flex:0 0 auto}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.pick-chip{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel2);color:var(--text2);padding:8px 16px;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.06em}
.pick-chip.active{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold);background:rgba(225,184,92,.12)}
.opt-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:8px}
.opt-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;padding:12px 14px;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--text);text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:.18s;width:100%}
.opt-card:hover{border-color:var(--gold)}
.opt-card.active{border-color:var(--gold);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(225,184,92,.14),rgba(225,184,92,.04))}
.opt-card b{font-size:15px;font-weight:600}
.opt-card p{margin:0;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--text2)}
.opt-card .tiny,.opt-card .eth{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.opt-card .temple-tag{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--gold)}
.opt-card .eth{margin-left:4px;letter-spacing:.04em}
.opt-card .gift-rarity{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--muted)}
.opt-card .gift-eff{margin-top:4px;line-height:1.6}
/* 两条路 */
.fork{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:22px;width:100%}
.paper-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;padding:28px 30px 24px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--rule);box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.45);text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;position:relative;font-family:var(--f-serif)}
.paper-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 36px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.55)}
.paper-card .hd{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.paper-card .hd span{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--seal)}
.paper-card .hd span.b{color:#6F859B}
.paper-card .hd i{font-family:var(--f-ital);font-style:normal;font-size:18px;color:var(--ink4)}
.paper-card h2{font-size:28px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--ink)}
.paper-card p{margin:0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.85;color:var(--ink3)}
.paper-card .steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink4);text-align:center}
.paper-card .steps div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.paper-card .steps i{height:3px;background:var(--seal);display:block}
.paper-card .steps div:nth-child(n+4) i{background:var(--pgold)}
.paper-card .fact{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink3)}
.paper-card .fact div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;padding:8px 10px;background:var(--paper3);border:1px solid var(--rule2)}
.paper-card .fact span{color:var(--ink4)}
.paper-card .fact b{font-weight:600}
.paper-card small{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink4)}
.paper-card .go{margin-top:4px;align-self:flex-start;padding:10px 18px;background:var(--seal);color:var(--paper);font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.1em;border:1px solid var(--seal)}
.paper-card .go.outline{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink)}
.fork-note{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:12px 18px;background:rgba(233,220,195,.08);border:1px solid rgba(233,220,195,.2);color:var(--text2);font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;width:100%}
.fork-note svg{width:20px;height:20px;flex:none}

/* ===== 直接构筑 ===== */
#sc-build{flex-direction:column}
.bd-top{flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;padding:calc(10px + var(--sat)) 26px 10px;background:rgba(8,12,30,.92);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-gold);position:relative;z-index:5}
.bd-steps{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;flex:1;min-width:0}
.bd-steps::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.bd-steps button{border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);padding:6px 0;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;border-bottom:2px solid transparent}
.bd-steps button.done{color:var(--gold)}
.bd-steps button.on{color:#F4F1FA;border-bottom-color:var(--gold)}
.bd-steps button[disabled]{cursor:default;opacity:.6}
.bd-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}
.bd-meta b{font-family:var(--f-latin);font-size:20px;color:var(--gold)}
.bd-meta .bar{width:120px;height:6px;background:rgba(231,228,242,.15);position:relative;display:inline-block}
.bd-meta .bar i{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;height:6px;background:var(--gold);width:0;transition:.3s}
.bd-body{flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex}
.bd-main{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow-y:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;padding:22px 30px calc(120px + var(--sab)) 34px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:22px}
.bd-step{display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}
.bd-step.on{display:flex;animation:scIn .35s ease both}
.bd-h{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.bd-h h2{font-size:20px;font-weight:900;color:#F4F1FA;letter-spacing:.04em}
.bd-h span{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6}
.bd-sub{font-size:13px;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.8;padding:10px 14px;border-left:2px solid var(--line);background:rgba(20,27,58,.4)}

 .bd-body{flex-direction:column}
 .bd-main{padding:16px 14px calc(220px + var(--sab))}
 .bd-aside{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;width:auto;border-left:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line-gold);padding:12px 16px calc(12px + var(--sab));gap:6px;max-height:42%;transition:.3s;transform:translateY(calc(100% - 118px));overflow:hidden}
 .bd-aside.open{transform:none;overflow-y:auto}
 .bd-aside h2{font-size:20px}
 .aside-toggle{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--seal);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.2em;padding:0;cursor:pointer;width:100%}
 .aside-toggle svg{width:14px;height:14px;transition:.3s}
 .bd-aside.open .aside-toggle svg{transform:rotate(180deg)}
 .bd-aside .hd{display:none}
 .bd-aside .fill{display:none}
 .aside-kv{grid-template-columns:56px minmax(0,1fr);font-size:12.5px}
 .stat-line{grid-template-columns:110px minmax(0,1fr) 62px;gap:4px 8px;padding:8px 10px}
 #sc-seal{align-items:stretch;justify-content:stretch}
 .seal{flex-direction:column;gap:18px;height:100%;padding:calc(20px + var(--sat)) 14px calc(30px + var(--sab));justify-content:flex-start;align-items:stretch}
 .seal-left{width:100%}
 .seal-left img{width:150px;height:150px}
 .seal-left h2{font-size:26px}
 .seal-paper{width:100%;max-width:none;height:auto;min-height:60vh;padding:24px 18px}
 .seal-paper .stamp{width:70px;height:70px;font-size:11px;right:14px;top:14px}
 .seal-paper pre{font-size:12.5px;max-height:none}
 .seal-raw{padding:24px 18px}
 .modal-box{padding:22px 18px}
}
@media (max-width:520px){
 .gate h1{font-size:34px}
 .menu h1{font-size:40px}
 .race-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
 .race-card{flex-direction:column;gap:6px;align-items:center;text-align:center}
 .race-card p{display:none !important}
 .tier-row{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
 .opt-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .talent-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .align-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .mp-facts{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
}

/* ===== 旅印手记 · 前半生 ===== */
#sc-journal{flex-direction:column;background:var(--paper2)}
#sc-journal.on{animation:paperIn .6s ease both}
@keyframes paperIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
.jr{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow-y:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--f-serif);position:relative;
 background-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 10% 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.5),transparent 50%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 100% 100%,rgba(176,141,60,.12),transparent 55%)}
.jr-art{position:relative;height:300px;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#24407A 0%,#4C74B8 34%,#9DBBDF 58%,#E6D7B9 80%,#6E7C5A 81%,#3E4A34 100%)}
.jr-art img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.jr-art .sky{position:absolute;left:8%;top:16%;width:34%;height:30%;border-radius:70px 90px 80px 70px;opacity:.55;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 40% 30%,#FFF8EA,#F1E4C8 45%,rgba(200,190,170,0) 100%)}
.jr-art .ridge{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:58%;height:42%;clip-path:polygon(0 60%,12% 42%,22% 55%,33% 30%,41% 48%,50% 18%,58% 40%,67% 26%,78% 46%,88% 34%,100% 52%,100% 100%,0 100%);background:rgba(50,62,85,.6)}
.jr-art .fade{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(42,27,16,.45),rgba(42,27,16,0) 36%,rgba(245,237,220,0) 62%,var(--paper) 100%)}
.jr-prog{position:absolute;left:20px;right:20px;top:calc(14px + var(--sat));display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;color:var(--paper);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.jr-prog .st{display:flex;gap:0;flex-wrap:wrap}
.jr-prog .st span{opacity:.75}
.jr-prog .st span.cur{color:#F2C35A;opacity:1;font-weight:600}
.jr-prog .st span.done{opacity:.95}
.jr-prog .st span+span:before{content:"·";margin:0 8px;opacity:.6}
.jr-prog .n{font-family:var(--f-ital);letter-spacing:0;font-size:14px;font-style:normal;white-space:nowrap;flex:none;margin-left:10px}
.jr-back{position:absolute;left:20px;top:calc(40px + var(--sat));border:1px solid rgba(245,237,220,.5);background:rgba(42,27,16,.35);color:var(--paper);font-size:12px;padding:5px 12px;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:.1em}
.jr-back:hover{background:rgba(42,27,16,.6)}
.jr-cap{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:0 40px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}
.jr-cap .ital{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--seal)}
.jr-cap h2{font-size:30px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.25}
.jr-cap .when{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink3)}
.jr-body{width:min(760px,100%);margin:0 auto;padding:10px 40px calc(40px + var(--sab));display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.95;color:var(--ink2)}
.jr-body p{margin:0;opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .8s ease forwards}
.jr-body p:nth-of-type(1){animation-delay:.15s}.jr-body p:nth-of-type(2){animation-delay:.55s}.jr-body p:nth-of-type(3){animation-delay:.95s}.jr-body p:nth-of-type(4){animation-delay:1.3s}
.jr-body p b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.jr-body p.dim{color:var(--ink3)}
.jr-body p.q{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.jr-ask{font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.24em;color:var(--seal);margin-top:6px;text-align:center}
.jr-ask:before,.jr-ask:after{content:"—";margin:0 8px;opacity:.7}
.jr-choices{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.jr-choice{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;text-align:left;padding:13px 16px;background:var(--paper3);border:1px solid var(--rule2);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;font-family:inherit}
.jr-choice:hover{border-color:var(--seal)}
.jr-choice.on{border-color:var(--seal);background:#FBF5E8;box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--seal)}
.jr-choice b{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.5}
.jr-choice span{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink4);line-height:1.6}
.jr-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:8px}
.jr-grid .jr-choice{padding:12px 14px}
.jr-grid .jr-choice b{font-size:14.5px}
.jr-grid .jr-choice img{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:1px solid var(--rule);background:#fff}
.jr-grid .jr-choice .rh{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.jr-grid .jr-choice small{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink4)}
.jr-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.jr-chip{font-size:13px;padding:6px 12px;border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--paper3);color:var(--ink2);cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:.04em;font-family:inherit}
.jr-chip.on{background:var(--seal);border-color:var(--seal);color:var(--paper);font-weight:600}
.jr-pathd{display:none;padding:12px 16px;background:#FBF5E8;border-left:3px solid var(--seal);font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--ink2)}
.jr-pathd.on{display:block}
.jr-pathd b{color:var(--ink)}
.jr-pathd .en{font-family:var(--f-ital);font-style:italic;color:var(--seal);letter-spacing:.06em;font-size:14px}
.jr-note{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink4);line-height:1.7;padding:10px 14px;border-left:2px solid var(--rule);background:rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.jr-note b{color:var(--ink2)}
.jr-foot{position:sticky;bottom:0;display:flex;gap:10px;padding:12px 40px calc(18px + var(--sab));background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(245,237,220,0),var(--paper) 30%);border-top:1px solid var(--rule);width:min(760px,100%);margin:0 auto}
.jr-foot button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.1em;padding:12px 16px;border:1px solid var(--rule);background:transparent;color:var(--ink3)}
.jr-foot button.main{flex:1;background:var(--seal);border-color:var(--seal);color:var(--paper)}
.jr-foot button.main:hover{background:#7A2219}
.jr-foot button.main[disabled]{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}
/* 觉醒结算 */
.jr-sum{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}
.jr-sum div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;padding:10px 12px;background:var(--paper3);border:1px solid var(--rule2)}
.jr-sum span{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink4);letter-spacing:.1em}
.jr-sum b{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
.jr-sum b.num{font-family:var(--f-latin);font-size:22px}
.jr-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px}
.jr-stats div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:0;padding:8px 4px;border:1px solid var(--rule2);background:var(--paper3)}
.jr-stats span{font-size:11px;color:var(--ink4);font-family:var(--f-latin);letter-spacing:.06em}
.jr-stats b{font-family:var(--f-latin);font-size:20px;color:var(--ink)}
.jr-skills{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--ink2)}
.jr-skills b{color:var(--seal);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1em;font-size:12px;margin-right:8px}
.jr-red{display:inline-block;padding:2px 10px;border:2px solid var(--seal);color:var(--seal);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.2em;transform:rotate(-4deg);opacity:.85;align-self:flex-start}
@media (max-width:900px){
 .jr-art{height:230px}
 .jr-cap{padding:0 20px 12px}
 .jr-cap h2{font-size:22px}
 .jr-body{padding:6px 20px calc(30px + var(--sab));font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.85}
 .jr-foot{padding:10px 20px calc(16px + var(--sab));padding-right:78px}
 .jr-foot button{padding:11px 12px;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.04em;white-space:nowrap}
 .jr-prog .st span:not(.cur):not(.done){display:none}
 .jr-prog .st span.done{display:none}
 .jr-prog .st span.cur:before{content:none}
 .jr-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
 .jr-sum{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
 .jr-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .jr-prog{left:14px;right:14px;font-size:11px}
 .jr-back{left:14px}
}

/* ===== v99 · 世界之书的入口一问与冷收束 ===== */
.cx-ask{margin:2px 0 14px;padding:0 0 0 14px;border-left:2px solid var(--gold);font-size:17px;line-height:1.75;color:#F4F1FA;letter-spacing:.03em;font-family:var(--f-serif)}
.cx-coda{margin:14px 0 4px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.22);font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--gold2);letter-spacing:.04em}
@media (max-width:900px){ .cx-ask{font-size:15.5px} }

/* ===== 地图详情卡：一句画面、一句冷的、原画 ===== */
.mp-art{height:220px}
.mp-art img{transition:opacity .4s ease}
.mp-art.noimg:after{content:"这张原画没加载出来（图床可能被网络挡住了）";position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 24px;text-align:center;color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.08em}
.mp-art .cap a{margin-left:10px;color:var(--gold2);text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap}
.mp-lead{margin:0;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.85;color:#F4F1FA;padding-left:12px;border-left:2px solid var(--gold)}
.mp-coda{margin:4px 0 0;padding-top:8px;border-top:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.22);font-size:13px;line-height:1.75;color:var(--gold2)}
@media (max-width:900px){ .mp-art{height:170px} .mp-lead{font-size:13.5px} }

/* ===== 风土人情 · 原画图录 ===== */
.folk-gal{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}
.folk-gal .fg-zone h4{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:14px;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.12em;text-align:left}
.folk-gal .fg-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:10px}
.folk-gal .fg-tile{position:relative;display:block;padding:0;border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.22);background:#0E1430;cursor:pointer;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:16/10;text-align:left;font-family:inherit}
.folk-gal .fg-tile img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .5s ease,opacity .4s ease}
.folk-gal .fg-tile:hover img{transform:scale(1.04)}
.folk-gal .fg-tile .fg-cap{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:18px 10px 7px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(6,9,26,0),rgba(6,9,26,.88));color:#F4F1FA;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45}
.folk-gal .fg-tile .fg-cap b{display:block;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--gold2);font-weight:600}
.folk-gal .fg-tile.noimg:after{content:"没加载出来";position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em}
.folk-gal .fg-note{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7}
@media (max-width:900px){ .folk-gal .fg-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px} .folk-gal .fg-tile .fg-cap{font-size:11px;padding:14px 8px 6px} }

/* ===== 神殿：开局岁数、旅印 ===== */
.stage-age{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:10px 0 2px;font-size:14px;color:var(--text2)}
.stage-age b{font-size:17px;color:var(--gold);min-width:56px;text-align:center;letter-spacing:.06em}
.stage-age .k-btn.sm{padding:4px 12px;font-size:15px}
#seal-pick{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:center}
#seal-pick .pick-chip{padding:6px 13px;font-size:13.5px}
#seal-pick .pick-chip[disabled]{opacity:.35;cursor:not-allowed}
#seal-pick .seal-hint{font-size:12px;margin-left:6px}
#origin-custom{display:none;margin-top:8px}

/* ===== 手记：逐段展开 ===== */
.jr-body p{opacity:1;animation:none}
.jr-body p.fresh{animation:fadeUp .7s ease both}
.jr-more{align-self:center;margin:2px 0 4px;padding:6px 18px;border:1px dashed var(--rule);background:transparent;color:var(--seal);font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.2em;cursor:pointer}
.jr-more:hover{border-style:solid;background:rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.jr-body{cursor:default}
.jr-choice .jr-leave{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--seal);opacity:.85;margin-top:2px}
.jr-art img.jr-img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;opacity:0;transition:opacity .6s ease}
.jr-art.has-img .sky,.jr-art.has-img .ridge{display:none}
.jr-art.has-img .fade{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(42,27,16,.55),rgba(42,27,16,.05) 34%,rgba(245,237,220,0) 58%,var(--paper) 100%)}
/* 手记页脚贴底：内容短的时候也在最下面 */
.jr{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.jr-art{flex:none}
.jr-body{flex:1 0 auto}
.jr-foot{flex:none}
#p_stage_block .hint{margin-top:2px}
#p_stage_block h3{margin-top:6px}

/* ===== v100 · 地标详情卡：原画 → 地名与类型 → 一整段讲述 → 折叠的资料 ===== */
.mp-head{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
.mp-head h2{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0}
.mp-dot{display:inline-block;flex:none;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:9px;box-shadow:0 0 8px currentColor}
.mp-head .sub{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text2);letter-spacing:.04em}
.mp-head .sub2{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.mp-head .sub2 b{font-weight:500;color:var(--gold2);border:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.35);padding:0 6px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.04em}
.mp-prose{white-space:pre-line;margin:2px 0 0;font-size:14.5px;line-height:2;color:#ECE9F5;text-align:justify;letter-spacing:.02em}
.mp-more{border-top:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.18);padding-top:8px}
.mp-more summary{cursor:pointer;list-style:none;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.12em;padding:4px 0;user-select:none}
.mp-more summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.mp-more summary:before{content:"▸";display:inline-block;margin-right:6px;transition:transform .2s ease}
.mp-more[open] summary:before{transform:rotate(90deg)}
.mp-more[open]>*:not(summary){animation:fadeUp .35s ease both}
.mp-more .mp-tags,.mp-more .mp-facts,.mp-more .mp-text{margin-top:8px}
@media (max-width:900px){ .mp-prose{font-size:14px;line-height:1.9} }
/* 全局 details 规则（port.css）会让它在 flex 列里被压扁：这里单独放开 */
.mp-body>*{flex:none}
.mp-more{overflow:visible;border:0;border-top:1px solid rgba(225,184,92,.18);border-radius:0;background:transparent;margin:0;padding:8px 0 0}
.mp-more>summary{background:transparent;padding:4px 0;font-weight:500;color:var(--gold)}

/* ===== v101 · 手记：胎骨偏向、选择留下了什么、结算拆成底子与这些年 ===== */
.jr-choice .jr-tilt{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink4);letter-spacing:.02em}
.jr-choice .jr-gain{font-size:12px;color:var(--seal);font-weight:600;margin-top:4px;letter-spacing:.02em;animation:fadeUp .35s ease both}
.jr-stats div i{font-style:normal;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--seal);letter-spacing:.02em;margin-top:1px}

/* ===== v102 · 种族专长与传承技艺 ===== */
.feat-box{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.feat-ask{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.06em;line-height:1.6}
.feat-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.feat-look{margin:0;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.75}
.feat-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;padding:12px 14px 12px 16px}
.feat-card .fh{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.feat-card .fh .k{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;padding:1px 8px;border:1px solid;white-space:nowrap}
.feat-card .fh b{font-size:16.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em}
.feat-card .fh i{font-style:normal;font-family:var(--f-latin);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.06em;opacity:.85}
.feat-card p{margin:0;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.75}
.feat-card p.r span{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.16em;margin-right:8px;opacity:.85}
.feat-card p.x{font-size:12.5px}
.feat-card p.u{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.7}
.feat-note{margin:0;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.75}
/* 手记：羊皮纸 */
.jr .feat-box{margin-top:2px}
.jr .feat-ask{color:var(--seal)}
.jr .feat-look,.jr .feat-note{color:var(--ink4)}
.jr .feat-look b{color:var(--ink2)}
.jr .feat-card{background:var(--paper3);border:1px solid var(--rule2);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--seal)}
.jr .feat-card.her{box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 #5E7048}
.jr .feat-card .fh .k{color:var(--seal);border-color:var(--seal)}
.jr .feat-card.her .fh .k{color:#4E6038;border-color:#4E6038}
.jr .feat-card .fh b{color:var(--ink)}
.jr .feat-card .fh i{color:var(--ink4)}
.jr .feat-card p{color:var(--ink2)}
.jr .feat-card p.u{color:var(--ink3)}
.jr .feat-card p.r,.jr .feat-card p.x{color:var(--ink3)}
.jr-choice .jr-feat-tag{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--seal);letter-spacing:.02em}
.jr-chip[disabled]{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
/* 星穹：构筑第 1 步、第 5 步 */
#bd-feat{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;margin-top:6px}
#bd-feat .feat-card,#race-line .feat-card{background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--gold)}
#bd-feat .feat-card.her,#race-line .feat-card.her{box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--ether)}
#bd-feat .feat-card .fh .k,#race-line .feat-card .fh .k{color:var(--gold);border-color:var(--line-gold)}
#bd-feat .feat-card.her .fh .k,#race-line .feat-card.her .fh .k{color:var(--ether);border-color:rgba(92,214,210,.45)}

  <div class="gate-pro">
   <p>迷宫纪1001年。护住世界的蛋壳早已碎了，黄金城和它的天使也退进了史书。葬火熄了，月银暗了，纷争纪一万一千年的仗打完，前代留下的剑和誓约，如今传到了又一批满十八岁的人手里。</p>
   <p>阿卡迪亚的永昼灯塔照着那道长阶，阶下是一百层的大迷宫。三十一年前，黑潮从这里涌上来席卷了大陆，诸族远征军又在这里把失守的防线夺了回来。如今星纱列车穿过东陆的麦田，渊月列车开进西陆的灯火，林间有人唱歌，山腹里锻锤不停，蝉鸣月的庆典也在筹备了。公会门前，老队伍等着还没回来的伙伴，年轻人为了头一趟去哪儿吵个没完。</p>
   <p>收好行囊。下一班前往阿卡迪亚的车，就要出发了。</p>

<div class="atlas-section-head"><h3>初到奥尔德兰</h3><span class="sigil">山河、诸国与尚未写下的远征</span></div>
<p class="cx-ask">收好地图，约上同行的人。下一程或许通向未见过的海，也或许有人正等你拔剑相助。</p>
<div class="wc-hero"><p class="wc-lead">从诸国的麦田、林海和群山出发，不管走哪条路，走到头都是大陆正中的阿卡迪亚。永昼灯塔照着冒险者归城的长阶，光环转过屋顶，长阶尽头的大迷宫朝地底敞着口。<br>迷宫纪这一千年里，冒险者从这口迷宫带回失落的宝藏和古代的名字。三十一年前黑潮从地底涌上来，诸族远征军也是在这里把它挡住的。远处的白碑长垒还横在大陆中间，墙东是诸国联邦，墙西是黑耀帝国。当年隔着墙对峙的两边，如今在同一座城里找队友。<br>迷宫纪1001年，第一兆已经出现。往后会怎样没人说得准，长曦月的远航和蝉鸣月的庆典倒已经有人在约了。你的第一程，也从这里定。</p></div>
<div class="wc-grid">
<div class="wc-card"><b>阿卡迪亚大迷宫</b><span>长阶之下，另有天地</span><p>走下长阶，地面的日光一级一级退去，遗迹的轮廓从暗处浮出来。石门后面可能是一座失落王朝的大殿，也可能是另一片天空。公会深度板记到第55层，黑潮远征曾到过第57层。潮汐还在改写前人画好的路，再往下的消息，得等下一支回来的远征队带上来。</p></div>
<div class="wc-card"><b>东大陆 · 诸国联邦</b><span>白城、圣林与骑士的旌旗</span><p>星纱列车穿过王道平原，白石城头飘着蓝金军旗。再往东，月镜王国的灯影铺在湖上，风铃王国的空艇从高原的云里探出帆来，世界树的枝叶底下是精灵的原初之森。晨曦帝国、三王国、公国群、圣堂、精灵、矮人和魔导都市，各奉各的誓约，打的是同一面联军旗。</p></div>
<div class="wc-card"><b>西大陆 · 黑耀帝国</b><span>红莲之下，七城相望</span><p>红莲悬在帝都上空，赤蓝两色的电光照着黑曜石的城墙。渊月列车开往魔族七城，车窗外掠过苍焰角城、血棘红园、白骨高塔和深海潮门。魔王巴尔缇娜用契约统着诸族，当年战报里叫人害怕的那几个城名，如今印在旅人的车票上。城里有庭院，有浴场，还有通宵不散的灯市。</p></div>
</div>
<div class="wc-strip">
<div class="wc-item"><b>领一枚旅印</b><p>见习旅印上刻着一颗还没展开的小星和一只罗盘。到公会登记，接下委托，再带着同行的人回来，你的履历就从这里记起。旅印从见习到圣歌共七阶，另有深印、战印两种特许。印阶越高，能接的任务、能进的地方越多。</p></div>
<div class="wc-item"><b>备好路上的盘缠</b><p>东西两大陆通用三种钱。一枚<i>赤金巴尔</i>换一百<i>月银索恩</i>，一索恩换一百<i>山铜便士</i>。一碗热汤四到八个便士，一把制式长剑三到八索恩。委托的报酬和带回来的素材，换成下一程的剑、药和船票。</p></div>
<div class="wc-item"><b>记住回城的路</b><p>补给带足，委托先在公会核过，撤退的信号和队友约好。遗物可能带着污染，回城的路也会随潮汐改道。十兆在逼近，眼下倒不妨先吃顿好饭，再去见约好的同行者。</p></div>
</div>
<p class="cx-coda">有人把祖辈的剑修好再度出发，有人在公会门前第一次握紧了它。</p>
<p class="wc-note">后续图录收录诸国、地貌、风俗与人物。任务及迷宫的详细攻略另有剧透提示。</p>
</section>
<section class="atlas-section-card atlas-pane" id="arc-geography">
<div class="atlas-section-head"><h3>山河与远方</h3><span class="sigil">五片土地 · 沿途风物与行旅</span></div>
<p class="cx-ask">循着灯塔、星辰与远山，你会遇见怎样的世界？</p>
<div class="arc-switch-wall geo-switch-wall"><div class="divine-sigil-head"><b>五片土地</b><span>从大陆腹地，走向传说的边界</span></div><div class="arc-switch-grid geo-switch-grid">
<button class="arc-switch-card geo-switch-card active" data-target="geo-central" onclick="showArcSwitch(this.closest('section').id,'geo-central',this)" type="button"><b>中央阿卡迪亚</b><span>永昼灯塔下的冒险之都</span></button>
<button class="arc-switch-card geo-switch-card" data-target="geo-east" onclick="showArcSwitch(this.closest('section').id,'geo-east',this)" type="button"><b>东大陆诸国联邦</b><span>白城与林海，湖国与长风</span></button>
<button class="arc-switch-card geo-switch-card" data-target="geo-west" onclick="showArcSwitch(this.closest('section').id,'geo-west',this)" type="button"><b>西大陆黑耀帝国</b><span>红莲长照，七城各有夜色</span></button>
<button class="arc-switch-card geo-switch-card" data-target="geo-races" onclick="showArcSwitch(this.closest('section').id,'geo-races',this)" type="button"><b>古老种族的领地</b><span>世界树荫、地底炉国与龙之群山</span></button>
<button class="arc-switch-card geo-switch-card" data-target="geo-frontier" onclick="showArcSwitch(this.closest('section').id,'geo-frontier',this)" type="button"><b>极地、沙海与边境</b><span>极光照雪，神骸埋沙，长垒横陆</span></button>
</div></div>
<div class="arc-switch-panel geo-pane" id="geo-central" data-panel="geo-central"><div class="geo-pane-head"><h4>中央阿卡迪亚</h4><span class="geo-kicker">永昼灯塔下的冒险之都</span></div><p class="geo-lead">大陆上的路走到头，都汇在中央的旧战原，阿卡迪亚就围着大迷宫建在这里。城区顺着地势一层层铺开，桥梁、塔楼和长阶都朝迷宫入口伸过去。抬头就能看见永昼灯塔，光环慢慢转过屋顶，也照着城外还没进城的商旅。<br>这里的城门容得下各国军旗，也容得下四处招募同伴的年轻人。清晨出发的队伍在旅印大厅碰头，晚归的冒险者把新探出的地名添上地图。过了热闹的市集再往下，更深处的世界到今天还没人说得清。</p><div class="geo-fact-grid">
<div class="geo-fact"><b>城中的去处</b><p>冒险者公会总部与旅印大厅、回收广场、鉴定所、残响市集，以及沿环道延伸的下城与外环街区。</p></div>
<div class="geo-fact"><b>旅途在此交汇</b><p>素材与遗物引来学者、工匠和商队，远征又把诸国的语言、料理与传说带回城中。你在这里找得到肯替你修一柄旧剑的人，也找得到愿意陪你过下一道石门的人。</p></div>
<div class="geo-fact"><b>启程须知</b><p>委托先在公会核过。遗物归谁有仲裁可循，污染物要交专人封存。潮汐过后重查路线，别凭上一趟的地图往深处走。</p></div>
</div><p class="cx-coda">归来时，认准灯塔。还有人在城门前等你。</p></div>
<div class="arc-switch-panel geo-pane" id="geo-east" data-panel="geo-east"><div class="geo-pane-head"><h4>东大陆诸国联邦</h4><span class="geo-kicker">白城与林海，湖国与长风</span></div><p class="geo-lead">晨曦的白城立在金色平原上，星纱列车拖着长长的白烟，驶过河谷与麦浪。往湖区去，月镜王国的灯影顺着水岸铺开。往高原去，风铃王国的空艇从云间投下帆影。更远处的原初之森遮天蔽日，矮人山国的炉火则在大地深处长明。<br>诸国各有各的君主、族裔与信仰。纷争纪一万一千年的战事里，他们一同守着长垒。仗打完修起来的道路和商路，又把各自的国土连成了今日的东陆。</p><div class="geo-fact-grid">
<div class="geo-fact"><b>山河与城邦</b><p>晨曦帝国、月镜、风铃与蔷薇三王国、公国群、星冠圣堂、精灵王庭、矮人王国和魔导都市。</p></div>
<div class="geo-fact"><b>沿途风物</b><p>骑士院外的晨训、七条朝圣道上的钟声、湖畔的夏夜和高原的飞帆，各有各的看头。每过一道国境，饮食、礼节和集市上的货物都跟着换一回。</p></div>
<div class="geo-fact"><b>行路须知</b><p>联邦各国各行本国的法度。备好通行文书和公会旅印，留意边境征召。争端牵涉到领主、教会或是古老的族约，先弄清当地归谁裁决。</p></div>
</div></div>
<div class="arc-switch-panel geo-pane" id="geo-west" data-panel="geo-west"><div class="geo-pane-head"><h4>西大陆黑耀帝国</h4><span class="geo-kicker">红莲长照，七城各有夜色</span></div><p class="geo-lead">渊月列车越过西陆旷野，沿途的麦田与牧场渐次退向窗后。帝都黑曜石的城垣升出地平线，红莲悬在高处，一到夜里，街道亮起赤红与幽蓝的电光。<br>角城的苍焰照着山壁，红园的血棘攀满了长廊，蓝堡的灯火则沉在海里。各族相貌不同，习俗和家传的手艺也不同，凭一纸契约同归一个帝国。到了节日，列车上挤满回乡的乘客。</p><div class="geo-fact-grid">
<div class="geo-fact"><b>帝国诸城</b><p>烬灭之都、红莲契约厅、法务院、七魔主城与连通其间的渊月铁路。城外另有农区、牧场及古战场。</p></div>
<div class="geo-fact"><b>契约下的生活</b><p>公民的身份和权利都写在契约上，外来人也能按约取得住下来、谋生计的资格。契约民的街区通着电灯和供水，吃住都有最低一档的保障。红莲夜里，人们约上亲友，到公共浴场和食堂聚一聚。</p></div>
<div class="geo-fact"><b>来访须知</b><p>入境和居留都要办相应的契约。条款仔细读清，科研区、军需设施和各城的圣域另要许可。旧战争留下的戒心，也不是一枚通行印记就能消掉的。</p></div>
</div></div>
<div class="arc-switch-panel geo-pane" id="geo-races" data-panel="geo-races"><div class="geo-pane-head"><h4>古老种族的领地</h4><span class="geo-kicker">世界树荫、地底炉国与龙之群山</span></div><p class="geo-lead">碧穹王庭沿世界树的枝干伸展，叶间的宫室和藤桥在暮色里亮起柔光。精灵循林脉修路。有些树径至今仍有人走，而当年与王庭互通使节的人类王朝，早已换了几代名字。<br>熔铁炉心悬在死火山的腹地，熔流跨过黑岩，像一道火色的瀑布，照亮锻炉和长街。再抬头望龙眠天脊，雷云缠着群峰。龙裔还守着古老的圣域，也守着黑潮之后越发珍重的传承。</p><div class="geo-fact-grid">
<div class="geo-fact"><b>诸族故乡</b><p>精灵的原初之森与碧穹王庭，矮人的炉心及诸支山城，龙裔氏族的天脊。其间还有半身人的丘陵商路与兽耳诸部的猎场。</p></div>
<div class="geo-fact"><b>做客的礼节</b><p>精灵林地的许可上写明了哪些地方能走，矮人的深层城坊要有人领着才进得去，龙裔的圣域要先有氏族点头。问路时记住对方报的称谓和禁忌，比亮钱袋管用。</p></div>
<div class="geo-fact"><b>古约与新邻</b><p>精灵和矮人曾为森林灵脉和矿藏争执过，各氏族之间也各有非守不可的旧誓。听懂主人为什么看重那片林地、那座矿山，一回寻常的做客，或许就能结下长久的交情。</p></div>
</div></div>
<div class="arc-switch-panel geo-pane" id="geo-frontier" data-panel="geo-frontier"><div class="geo-pane-head"><h4>极地、沙海与边境</h4><span class="geo-kicker">极光照雪，神骸埋沙，长垒横陆</span></div><p class="geo-lead">北境的极光掠过化圣雪原，寒天之钉周围仍凝着不合时序的风雪，亥珀波瑞亚遗址沉在冰层底下。南边，神陨沙海覆没了纷争纪的战场，神血结晶在砂砾间闪着光，巨大的神骸投下比暮色更深的影子。<br>白碑长垒横穿中央旧战原，墙外蓝色的战魂慢慢游移。纷争纪里替筑垒争时间的那批人早已不在了，城头的守军也换过不知多少代。商旅仍沿着长垒来往，借它挡旷野的风。</p><div class="geo-fact-grid">
<div class="geo-fact"><b>遥远的目的地</b><p>寒天之钉与亥珀波瑞亚遗址、神骨峡谷、白碑断门，以及边境公国散布的古堡和驿站。</p></div>
<div class="geo-fact"><b>路上的人</b><p>北境的猎队熟悉风雪与迁徙，沙海的引路人认得埋在砂里的铜祷牌，边地的驿站替远行人养马备粮。有人来寻遗迹，有人跑商路，还有驻军守着，这些地方就一直有人住。</p></div>
<div class="geo-fact"><b>远行须知</b><p>暴风、严寒、缺水、神骸辐射和魔物外溢，各有各的险处。先向熟悉当地的人请教，补给备足，退路留好。长垒外的蓝色战魂不主动伤人，别只因为害怕就先动手。</p></div>
</div><p class="cx-coda">地图边缘仍有空白。准备周全，再把脚印留到那里。</p></div>
</section>
<section class="atlas-section-card atlas-pane" id="arc-clock">
<div class="atlas-section-head"><h3>世界的钟</h3><span class="sigil">潮汐十兆 · 六条世界主线 · 诸邦正在发生的冒险</span></div>
<p class="cx-ask">迷宫纪1001年，最初的异变已在远山出现。你将在这一年启程。</p>

<div class="clock-lead">
<p><b>潮汐十兆</b>一次接一次地来，山川、城邦和众生的境遇都跟着改。<b>每两年一次，一共十次</b>，直到最后的交战。</p>
<p>魔兽离开旧巢，迷宫越过原来的边界，沉寂的遗迹又点起灯来。往后海渊和天穹也会裂开新的口子，诸国得一次次重新集结。</p>
<p class="clock-hope">第十兆到来，这场灾变便到了尽头，通往结局的那条路也从那里起步。</p>
</div>

<div class="arc-switch-wall">
<div class="divine-sigil-head"><b>十兆</b><span>从最初征兆到最后一战</span></div>
<div class="arc-switch-grid clock-grid">

<div class="arc-switch-panel clock-pane active" id="clock-omens" data-panel="clock-omens">
<div class="omen-list">
<div class="omen now"><span class="omen-no">兆一</span><div><b>魔兽离巢</b><p>山中魔兽提前离开冬巢，沿着往年安静的道路逼近村落。猎户最先察觉，这不是换季的动静。<br>商队护卫费已涨两成，公会提高了部分路线的推荐人数。来往的旅人还只当是这一年反常，没看出更远的征兆。<i>你的第一段旅途，就从这样的消息中开始。</i></p></div></div>
<div class="omen"><span class="omen-no">兆二</span><div><b>迷宫长芽</b><p>新的迷宫在大地各处出现，旧入口随之扩张，原本熟悉的道路需要重新测绘。</p></div></div>
<div class="omen"><span class="omen-no">兆三</span><div><b>遗迹点灯</b><p>沉寂几千年的古代遗迹一处接一处亮起，封死的石门重新显出纹路，失落的路就等人来走。</p></div></div>
<div class="omen"><span class="omen-no">兆四</span><div><b>亡者归来</b><p>亡者重新踏上生前走过的路，有的循着旧旗行军，有的仍能认出故人的面孔。</p></div></div>
<div class="omen"><span class="omen-no">兆五</span><div><b>元素乱季</b><p>时令和元素都乱了套，雪原起火，沙海降雨，诸国遭的灾，旧日的经验全对不上。</p></div></div>
<div class="omen"><span class="omen-no">兆六</span><div><b>龙群迁徙</b><p>飞龙、海龙这些龙类离开住惯了的地方，迁徙的影子掠过天际。沿途的居民开始转移，观测的人急报它们的去向。</p></div></div>
<div class="omen"><span class="omen-no">兆七</span><div><b>深海开门</b><p>深海裂隙开启，旧潮表失效，领航者必须重新寻找归港的时机。</p></div></div>
<div class="omen"><span class="omen-no">兆八</span><div><b>神火黯淡</b><p>维系庇护的神火渐弱，祷告难再得到回应。圣堂与信众仍守着祭坛，寻找神明沉默的缘由。</p></div></div>
<div class="omen"><span class="omen-no">兆九</span><div><b>天穹裂门</b><p>天穹撕开裂门，原本只见于异界残响的景象，开始出现在众人头顶。</p></div></div>
<div class="omen final"><span class="omen-no">兆十</span><div><b>万迷宫齐鸣</b><p>万千迷宫一齐鸣响，中央大迷宫开出最后一道门，所有远征到头来都要面对门后的核心。<br>灾兆到此为止，再没有下一兆。总得有人走进门后，奥尔德兰还有没有此后的年月，就看这一趟。</p></div></div>
</div>
<p class="omen-note">潮汐按定好的时序推进。<br>城池守不守得住，商路通不通，受困的人回不回得来，还是看一次次实打实的行动。提前送出去的消息、按时赶到的援军，都可能改掉灾难落下来时的结果。</p>
</div>

<p class="clock-sub">六条世界主线同时往前伸。起头碰上的也许只是一件遗物、一处异常，等更多的见证碰到一起，藏在年月里的关联才看得出来。</p>
<div class="spoiler-bar">

 <span class="spoiler-note">以下内容揭示六条世界主线的主题与深层设定。任务全谱另以独立卡片列出详细事件和推进条件。</span>

<div class="line-list">
<div class="line-card" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="qzEnter();setTimeout(function(){qzOpen('m1')},60)"><span class="line-no">其一</span><b>百层迷宫与未至之境</b><p>公会的深度板记到第五十五层，黑潮远征曾到过第五十七层。再往下的路，还等着回来的队伍作证。</p>
 <div class="spoiler-body"><b>线索将通向：</b>阿卡迪亚大迷宫是外来恶神伸进世界的器官，最深处是吞界之心。越往下探，它的本相露得越多，潮汐十兆最后引向的决战就在这里。</div></div>
<div class="line-card" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="qzEnter();setTimeout(function(){qzOpen('m2')},60)"><span class="line-no">其二</span><b>未被选择者的黑海</b><p>深层的街巷挂着陌生的旗，石墙上刻着没人读得懂的字。它们存着异界文明的残响，那些世界却早已覆灭。</p>
 <div class="spoiler-body"><b>线索将通向：</b>世界之外，那些没被选中的可能，连同它们的怨念，汇成了深渊黑海，恨的是还能自己做选择的生命。迷宫里的异界残片，是别的世界给吞掉之后剩下的见证。</div></div>
<div class="line-card" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="qzEnter();setTimeout(function(){qzOpen('m3')},60)"><span class="line-no">其三</span><b>造物主离席之后</b><p>星环的学者在山川和古代遗存里发现一些太过整齐的对应。他们疑心，奥尔德兰今日的形貌，当初是照着一个更古老的意志安排的。</p>
 <div class="spoiler-body"><b>线索将通向：</b>原初之主造了这个世界，为的是一场目的明确的试验。祂后来认定试验失败，就离开了这里。山川和遗存里留下的证据，会一点点揭出当初的规划，以及祂离去的缘由。</div></div>
<div class="line-card" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="qzEnter();setTimeout(function(){qzOpen('m4')},60)"><span class="line-no">其四</span><b>双王与那场灰色的雨</b><p>巴尔缇娜花了六百年筹建和平，山铜纪661年的灰雨却在一夜之间毁掉了它的根基。她和索恩薇娅从此分道，各自立起一套庇护众生的秩序，也把两种不同的答案留给了后世。</p>
 <div class="spoiler-body"><b>线索将通向：</b>灰雨的真相和公开的史书对不上。索恩薇娅拿制度护着凡世，巴尔缇娜靠力量和契约挡灾厄。一千多年过去，两条路一边争执一边合作，一直走到今天。</div></div>
<div class="line-card" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="qzEnter();setTimeout(function(){qzOpen('m5')},60)"><span class="line-no">其五</span><b>沉眠山腹的诸王</b><p>龙脊深处，矿工发现温热晶脉带着近似鳞片的纹理，偶尔还能感到岩层缓慢起伏。矿图中从未记过这样的脉动。</p>
 <div class="spoiler-body"><b>线索将通向：</b>凡世的元素承的是古老的龙权，群山里还埋着沉眠的王躯。顺着矿脉往深处走，旅人会慢慢知道诸王当年立下的誓约，也会发现今天的开采正在惊动什么。</div></div>
<div class="line-card" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="qzEnter();setTimeout(function(){qzOpen('m6')},60)"><span class="line-no">其六</span><b>射穿天穹的那一箭</b><p>黄金城曾朝天穹射出一支神箭，为的是让世人能自己选往后的路。箭光击碎了庇护世界的蛋壳，从那以后，城中人和天使一同迎上了裂口外头的灾难。</p>
 <div class="spoiler-body"><b>线索将通向：</b>虚假之天原本是隔开外界的一层护壳。射箭的人打破了它，世人从此能自己选往后的路，深渊和异界也从此有了靠近世界的裂口。后来的人得接着守住这片已经敞开的天。</div></div>
</div>
<p class="omen-note">线索分别存在遗迹、旧档、残响和亲历者的证词里。它们会随着探索一点点连起来，寻常的交谈不会直接给出整条主线的答案。</p>
</div>

<div class="arc-switch-panel clock-pane" id="clock-end" data-panel="clock-end">
<p class="clock-sub">第十兆到来，诸国与远征者将共同迎接最后一场战役。</p>
<div class="line-list">
<div class="line-card"><b>诸国军团与灰雨远征军</b><p>晨曦圣君统率军团固守东大陆，魔王率七城与魔神将深入地底和裂隙，从另一条战线迎击灾厄。<i>而通往核心的最后一程，仍需要一支能够深入其中的小队。</i></p></div>
<div class="line-card"><b>深入吞界之心</b><p>一路同行到如今的旅伴、远征得来的神器，还有在六大地区结下的盟友，到这时都派得上用场。通往核心的最后一程，还得你和队伍自己走完。</p></div>
<div class="line-card"><b>战役之后</b><p>打赢之后，破了的天穹还得修，壳外的威胁也没有消尽。诸国得凭手里已有的知识、盟约和力量，接着把这个世界修成能长久住下去的样子。</p></div>
<div class="line-card"><b>更远的地方</b><p>壳外还有来意不明的文明。奥尔德兰若是熬过了灾变，又走出一条新路，<i>当年离去的原初之主，也可能再回头望向这里。</i></p></div>
</div>
<p class="omen-note">这些都是远征走到末尾才会碰上的问题。眼下，旅人还是先从第一份委托、第一个同伴和第一段没走过的路开始。</p>
</div>
